manualReview.scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0134; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Target examples ‘The blue one looks pretty.’ and ‘It looks pretty too.’ were checked for grammar, idiomaticity, and the bounded pretty sense.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently maps pretty to «زیبا» within the lesson’s bounded sense and keeps prompts concise.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: A03, A04, A05, and A08 use grammatical, natural distractors, explicit model contrast audits, and distinct option-specific Persian teaching feedback.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: Only pretty is a new lexical target; sentences remain short and controlled while one A1 grammar candidate is practiced.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The second exchange changes the immediate context while preserving the same bounded sense of pretty.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, target construction, story, learner turns, activities, and final retrieval all point to the same lesson objective.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

runtimeAssetGrounding.evidence: No image/photo/visual is claimed. Listening and reconstruction reference only T01–T04/T02, all marked audioRequired, and the supplying dialogue appears earlier as A02.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the specified pretty sense is reviewed as new material.
